s0_ARB.articles-v1-f1: I live in house with my family. My father is engineer and he has a car.
s0_ARB.articles-v1-f2: Yesterday I go to market with my brother. I buy an apple and big bag of rice.
s0_ARB.articles-v2-f1: My school is big school in Cairo. I have a good teacher and I sit near window.
s0_ARB.articles-v2-f2: I like Alexandria, it is city near the sea. There is a beautiful beach and old library.
